idea-plugin.name: Declutter Tree
idea-plugin.description:
Declutter Tree customizes the Project View file ordering in IntelliJ IDEA. It keeps folders on top, groups Java files by declaration type, and moves metadata files like package-info.java to the bottom of their directory.

Features

  • Bottom file anchoring: Places designated files (such as package-info.java) at the very bottom of each directory, below regular files.
  • Folders on top: Keeps directories pinned above files in all view modes.
  • Type-based ordering: Groups Java files by structure: Interfaces → Abstract Classes → Classes → Records → Enums → Annotations.
  • Alphabetical sorting: Keeps files within each group sorted alphabetically from A to Z.
  • Configurable: Manage custom bottom filenames and toggle sorting options in Settings → Appearance & Behavior → Declutter Tree.

Performance

  • Fast-path in-memory checks without loading syntax trees (ASTs) or hitting disk during tree rendering.
  • Zero object allocations in directories with no matching files.
  • Implements DumbAware so scrolling and rendering remain responsive during background indexing.
  • Preserves Git status colors, bookmarks, breadcrumbs, and selection state.
